stem: Fenwick Analytics wants to pin a provider so patch-level updates install automatically, but an accidental jump to the next minor version is blocked. Which constraint expresses that?
rationale: The `~>` operator allows only the right-most component to increment, so `~> 2.4.0` allows patch releases like 2.4.1 but blocks 2.5.0. `>= 2.4.0` allows any later version at all, including future minor and major releases, so it does not block anything. `= 2.4.0` blocks every update, including the patch releases the requirement wants to allow automatically. `!= 2.5.0` only excludes that one exact version and still allows 2.6.0 or 3.0.0, so it does not block the next minor version in general.
